blurb: Dredge Harbor Boat Center, LLC In 1939, Bill Parsons Sr. and his brother Herb traded their interest in two cars for a down payment on a sandpit located along the riverfront. The riverfront was being dredged and the brothers had the foresight to see the potential of the future boating needs of the area. Dredge
